# Thomas Lynde

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Thomas Lynde is described as a meek, little man. His diminutive physical presence is a notable aspect of his appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek little man. Among the people of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he is commonly known as "[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who lives near [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and frequently visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). By the end of Anne's third school year in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Thomas suffers from poor health, a situation that Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) during one of her visits.

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). While Thomas himself rarely takes center stage in household affairs, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) routinely manages their domestic life and frequently visits neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to share gossip and opinions. Through their shared home, he supports her active involvement in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
